evidence.title: Clave readme
evidence.locator: Download; Windows early; Agent plugin; Features; Requirements; License
evidence.finding: Documents parallel agent PTYs, Mac and early Windows installers, local/SSH work, a separate server, a Git diff/commit panel and an agent plugin that writes workspace files.

evidence.title: Clave src/shared/agent-launch.ts
evidence.finding: The pinned source has built-in launch profiles for claude, agy, codex, pi and opencode, with distinct owned resume/session/permission flags.

evidence.title: Clave docs/adr/0001-agent-launch-profiles-and-capabilities.md
evidence.finding: Typed launch profiles retain wrapper argument arrays and agent-owned session/resume integration; Pi has explicitly scoped Mac capabilities.

evidence.title: Clave docs/server-install.md
evidence.locator: Opening scope; Before you start; Install; options
evidence.finding: A user-installed daemon owns sessions/history on Linux or macOS and continues after the Mac disconnects. It uses a private bearer-token HTTP endpoint over Tailscale/SSH, available from3.0.0-beta.6.

evidence.title: Clave src/renderer/src/components/git/GitDiffPreview.tsx
evidence.locator: GitDiffPreview; diff request and DiffLinesView content rendering
evidence.finding: The Git diff preview opens changed file content and renders actual parsed patch rows, not only a diffstat/file list.

evidence.title: Clave src/renderer/src/components/git/DiffLinesView.tsx
evidence.finding: The line renderer displays line.content with add/delete/context prefixes and hunk-specific colors, as well as loading/error/no-change states.

evidence.title: Clave docs/routines/README.md
evidence.locator: Proposed example routine; runsOn; machine-owned routine creation
evidence.finding: Documents workspace-file and machine-owned routines, cron configuration, explicit run location, per-machine stores and product routine-create/run tools.

evidence.title: Clave src/main/routines/scheduler.ts
evidence.locator: tick decision function and module header
evidence.finding: This pure module decides run/skip/fail from due occurrences, catch-up and active-run inputs. Its header points to service.ts for the30-second tick and actual run start.

evidence.title: Clave src/main/routines/launch.ts
evidence.finding: The launch module resolves a routine into typed SpawnOptions using the same agent/profile/account rules as clave_open_session. Actual sessions.start happens in service.ts.

evidence.title: Clave ROADMAP.md
evidence.locator: Deferred: Agent tab status indicators for Antigravity
evidence.finding: The official roadmap calls Antigravity tab status indicators deferred and undated; it does not commit a delivery date.

evidence.title: Clave CHANGELOG.md
evidence.locator: Dated version headings at pinned source commit
evidence.finding: Read the pinned changelog as source-branch history, distinct from newer prerelease release rows.
